en.name: Raises compensation for school physicians and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Work-Related Accidents of School Physicians, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Katsushika City Schools
en.summary: The current ordinance sets monthly maximum amounts for nursing care compensation at ¥85,490 and ¥42,700, and funeral compensation at ¥315,000. This bill changes these amounts to ¥90,790, ¥45,400, and ¥330,000, respectively. The changes apply to compensation for which the reason for payment arises on or after April 1, 2026.
changes: Raises the monthly maximum amount for nursing care compensation from ¥85,490 to ¥90,790
Raises the monthly maximum amount for nursing care compensation from ¥42,700 to ¥45,400
who: School physicians at Katsushika City schools
School dentists at Katsushika City schools
School pharmacists at Katsushika City schools
en.why: The ward says this is to revise the monthly maximum amounts for nursing care compensation and adjust related provisions.
